subject: Internal API for objectGetLFUFrequencyReadOnly (#5448)
reason: The change only extracts already-existing inline code in rdbSaveKeyValuePair (lfu_getFrequency(objectGetLRU(val), &freq)) into a new internal helper objectGetLFUFrequencyReadOnly with an identical body, plus a server.h declaration and comment updates. The helper is called from the same single call site with the same semantics, so the RDB LFU byte written and the no-write-back behaviour during forked/forkless saves are unchanged on both builds. A pure refactor with no behaviour change needs no scenario.
